title: Converting a dictionary to JSON text
description: You can follow a Python dictionary into a serialized string.

steps.description: You import json and create a dictionary with name, age and city. Its values include strings and an integer.

steps.question: Does dumps write this dictionary to a file?
steps.answer: No. It returns a JSON string, which the assignment stores in json_string.

steps.description: json_string now holds the serialized text. You can pass that returned value to another operation.
You see the JSON object printed with John, 30 and New York. This example displays the string without opening a file.
